# Kernel fixtures

These are curated excerpts from real kernel files on the development Gentoo
host. They retain authentic syntax while remaining small enough for focused
tests.

- `config-5.10.76-gentoo-r1-x86_64`: `/boot/config-5.10.76-gentoo-r1-x86_64`
- `config-6.0.5-gentoo-x86_64`: `/usr/src/linux-6.0.5-gentoo/.config`
- `Kconfig.preempt-6.0.5`: Linux 6.0.5 `kernel/Kconfig.preempt`
- `Kconfig.preempt-7.1.5`: Linux 7.1.5 `kernel/Kconfig.preempt`

The Kconfig excerpts remain under the Linux kernel's GPL-2.0-only license.
